== Framework Structure

This is `gesinn-it-docs-master-pub` — a shared documentation library included as a Git submodule in consumer repositories.

Three content levels:

* `snippets/` — atomic blocks, no heading, inline-embeddable
* `sections/` — standalone sections with a `==` heading (Level 2)
* `documents/` — full document templates that assemble sections and snippets

Scope folders: `universal/`, `mediawiki/`, `nodejs/`, `ansible/`, `php/`, `framework/`
